title: What if a bat bit you on Halloween?
premise: A bat bites you while you're out on Halloween. What happens next, and what actually saves you.

intro.title: What if a *bat* bit you on Halloween?
intro.subtitle: REAL MEDICINE · NOT MEDICAL ADVICE

beats.caption: Something brushes your hand in the dark. It barely stings.

tooltip.label: FACT
tooltip.text: Bat teeth are tiny. A bite can leave a mark you can barely see, or none at all.

beats.caption: It's easy to shrug off. That's exactly the danger.
Rabies is one of the deadliest viruses known.
The first thing that helps is simple: scrub the bite hard.
Then straight to a doctor. Treatment works if it starts before symptoms.
You feel completely normal. That's how rabies works.

tooltip.label: WHY IT'S SNEAKY
tooltip.text: Rabies usually takes 1 to 3 months to cause symptoms. By then, it's almost always too late.

beats.caption: Untreated, the virus would be creeping silently toward your brain.

stat.label: PEOPLE DIE OF RABIES EACH YEAR (WHO ESTIMATE)

beats.caption: Almost every one of those deaths is preventable.
Thanks to a few shots, you're fine. Never ignore a bat bite.

end.sub: BITTEN OR SCRATCHED BY A BAT? SEE A DOCTOR THE SAME DAY.
